findings.evidence: The light/dark sections repeat standard CSS-variable wiring such as "--color-action: var(--brand-action-light);" and "--color-action: var(--brand-action-dark);". This boilerplate adds little knowledge beyond the stronger state-contract, DTCG compatibility and adoption guidance.
findings.fix: Replace the duplicated light/dark property lists with a compact semantic-role/state table and one representative theme override. Preserve the state selectors and the non-obvious browser-validation guidance.

findings.evidence: "Move one consumer per release onto the new tokens while the deprecated aliases keep the rest working." This fixes migration batch size regardless of consumer independence, release cadence or validated migration tooling.
findings.fix: Make one consumer the initial migration default, then allow larger batches when pilot checks pass and consumer release constraints permit. Keep alias compatibility and the removal window mandatory.

findings.evidence: The error selector is ".field[aria-invalid="true"]", but the supplied FormField usage renders "<input {...props} type="email" />" without a field class. Following both examples sets aria-invalid but never applies the semantic error-border rule.
findings.fix: Add className="field" to the rendered input and include an example with an error prop, so the demonstrated control actually matches the error selector and uses --color-danger.
